newsitem.title: USA: Caterpillar acquires mining machine rights.
newsitem.headline: Caterpillar acquires mining machine rights.

text.p: Caterpillar Inc, the world's largest construction and mining equipment maker, said Friday it has purchased the rights to design, manufacture and market two large wheel dozers for use in large mines.
The rights were acquired for an undisclosed sum from Tiger Engineering Pty Ltd of Perth, Australia.
The large wheel dozers are also used by power utilities in handling coal stock piling, Caterpillar said.
Caterpillar is not saying how many of the machines it expects to sell, a spokeswoman said.
Caterpillar shares were up 1-15/16 at 114-3/4 Friday.
